title: [review] lora_ipv6_mesh-mkk4: SCHC OSCORE rule 5/6 vectors removed from schc_compression.json
description: Commit ef3111da3b removed the oscore_linklocal (rule 5) and oscore_global (rule 6) test vectors from test/vectors/schc_compression.json. All three implementations (Rust, Python, C) still have active implementations and tests for rules 5/6. The Rust test_schc_rule_coverage now prints non-fatal warnings about missing vectors. The removal breaks cross-implementation interop validation - without canonical shared vectors, we cannot verify that all three implementations produce identical compressed output for OSCORE packets. The vectors were correctly re-added in commit 79182a69b6 and should not have been removed again.
